newsitem.title: CANADA: Memotec shares rise on takeover rumors.
newsitem.headline: Memotec shares rise on takeover rumors.

text.p: Shares in networking technology firm Memotec Communications Inc rose swiftly on Tuesday on takeover rumors before subsiding as the speculation cooled.
"The takeover speculation surrounding Memotec is starting to heat up based on a number of factors," said Robert MacLellan, an analyst at Dillon Read.
Talk of a possible Memotec takeover was given added impetus by the takeover last week of private networking company Netlink by Cabletron Systems for about US$155 million worth of Cabletron shares.
"We're hearing that a U.S. deal was done at a nice multiple last week," said one trader.

Analysts said Cabletron paid a hefty multiple of Netlink annual sales, which are believed to be roughly US$10 million. "It's inappropriate to assign the same multiple to Memotec. Netlink is a pure frame relay company," MacLellan said.
He said that the rumored buyer for Memotec was ACT Networks Inc at a price of C$8 a share.
"Rumors are going to come and go. I think I've heard eight different rumors in the past six months," MacLellan said.
"I believe that Memotec is a very nice takeover candidate because of its voice over frame relay technology. But a rumor is just that -- a rumor," he added.

Netlink and Memotec are both considered hot prospects because of specialized frame relay products in their portfolios that allow compressed voice signals to be carried toll-free over far-flung corporate computer networks.
In June, Northern Telecom Ltd snatched up another larger player in this technology, MICOM Communications Corp, for US$12 a share.

There have also been a number of re-sale deals involving similar technologies, including one between Lucent Technologies Inc and Hyprecom and another between Motorola and Northern Telecom, MacLellan said.
Memotec shares were up 0.80 at 7 on the Toronto Stock Exchange after earlier hitting 8.
-- Sarah Edmonds, Reuters Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8100, E-mail sarah.edmonds@reuters.com
